mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ur_sport_checkin WHERE db_status = 1 AND (6371000 * 2 * ASIN(SQRT( POWER(SIN((#{latitude} - latitude) * PI() / 360), 2) + COS(#{latitude} * PI() / 180) * COS(latitude * PI() / 180) * POWER(SIN((#{longitude} - longitude) * PI() / 360), 2) ))) <= 5000 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 80
